task.pr_title: Prototype: Entity linking with custom KBs

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
On the topic of empty Docs, is the iteration here OK?

If I understand correctly, `all_ent_cands` has one element per Doc. Those elements (lists) can be empty if a Doc has no entities, but they are always present.

Here the input Docs and `all_ent_cands` are iterated separately. Because of the early `continue` for Docs with no tokens, wouldn't that result in a misalignment, because the `all_ent_cands` generator wouldn't be advanced?

evidence.thread_resolution:
rmitsch: > If I understand correctly, all_ent_cands has one element per Doc. 

Well, one list of lists (a list of candidate entities per entity in this doc).

> Here the input Docs and all_ent_cands are iterated separately. Because of the early continue for Docs with no tokens, wouldn't that result in a misalignment, because the all_ent_cands generator wouldn't be advanced?

Hm, with this

```python
all_ent_cands = self.get_candidates_all(
                self.kb,
                (
                    [doc.ents[idx] for idx in next(valid_ent_idx_per_doc)]
                    for doc in docs
                    if len(doc.ents)
                ),
            )
```
I check for `len(doc.ents)` (i.e. the document is ignored and hence not in the returned generator if no entities are available), but in the loop you marked the check is `len(doc)`. So I think you are right, there could be a misalignment if a doc has no entities. 

Corresponding adjustments are in https://github.com/explosion/spaCy/pull/11669/commits/9c69c3c3134c6ab03708b7e23db38548f67a5f19, but I'll also add tests later to test this specific situation.
rmitsch: I added a [test to check for this](https://github.com/explosion/spaCy/pull/11669/files#diff-60c79e322819366d1dcdbec89602b0c008dc4b8f15832da6ca6ffe8ebf666fb6R1214), but I'm running into the problem that motivated https://github.com/explosion/spaCy/pull/11640 - perhaps we can merge that?
